pairs.evidence: src/components/PageTransition.tsx:56 The root route wrapper starts transparent, making visible first content depend on hydration and its entrance animation for visitors without reduced motion.

techniques.evidence: src/components/CookieConsent.tsx:98 The consent banner appears after mount as a fixed overlay, avoiding insertion into document flow.

src/components/NavbarLogoGlyph.tsx:49 The shared 56-by-56 navbar logo unconditionally requests priority across routes, contrary to the rule against prioritizing a shared image unless it is every route's largest element.

src/lib/animations.ts:121 PageTransition applies this initial variant around route content; its CSS visibility override is restricted to reduced motion, leaving ordinary first paint hidden until script reveals it.
